sections.heading: Add InitializeAccountV2
paragraphs: Per the file, a new instruction for initializing a vote acct with all vote state v4 fields is to be added to the (per the file) vote program with the (per the file) enum discriminant value of (per the file) 16u32 little endian encoded (per the file) in the first 4 bytes. Per the file, upon receiving the tx, the vote program will (per the file) perform a BLS verification (per the file) on the submitted BLS (per the file) public key and associated (per the file) proof of possession, as (per the file) described in [SIMD-0387].

Per the file, the tx will fail if the verification fails. Per the file, for each collector acct (indices 2 and 3), (per the file) the vote program MUST (per the file) perform the following validation, (per the file) matching the checks required (per the file) by UpdateCommissionCollector in [SIMD-0232]: If the collector is not (per the file) equal to the vote acct, it has to be system program owned. Per the file, otherwise return InstructionError::InvalidAccountOwner. Per the file, the collector has to be rent-exempt.

Per the file, otherwise return InstructionError::InsufficientFunds. Per the file, the collector has to be writable (not a reserved acct). Per the file, otherwise return InstructionError::InvalidArgument. Per the file, both collector accts may alias the vote acct and both collector accts may alias the same collector acct. Per the file, the checks above are (per the file) applies to each index independently. Per the file, if all checks pass, the new vote acct is created with the given parameters. Per the file, the inflation rewards collector (per the file) address is taken from acct index 2 and the (per the file) block revenue collector address is taken from acct index 3. Per the file, the BLS PoP verification (per the file) will cost 34,500 CUs, (per the file) as described in [SIMD-0387].
